title: xdrip shows no data from libre2 Patch
body:
Hi,
I installed the patched libre2 app and the newest xdrip on S8 android9.
Everything seemed fine but I do not see any BG values in xdrip…. I chose libre patched app" as data source, files and location are ON for the LibreApp, all alarms are on in libreApp (but it didnt ask for any permissions in alarms, should it?).
what could be wrong??
Thanks in advance!
arsi

Hey folks, 

tried just yesterday to get my bg-values to xdrip for seeing them on my new smartwatch. 
I compiled the patched Libre2 App with TinoKossmann and all worked fine. 
I got the apk and installed it on ma Smartphone (Android 10).  I installed xDrip+ NightlyBuild,  i've chosen LibreLink2 patched and I started my Sensor (scanned on both Apps).  
Libre2 is working fine but there are no Values on xDrip.  In LibreLink2 there is a red "! " at the ArlamFunction in the App - the Arlam are working...
You see it's just the same Problem as  for arsin,  i think... 

Now the Link of k2s is sadly made down,  so anyone who could tell me,  what there was behind this link,  that solved the Problem of arsin and perhaps will solve mine? 


Edit:/
Ok damn,  that you've just have to know 😂😂😂
Got it working: 
It seems like you put your phone to SILENT,  the Libre2-App thinks,  that it have to remain like this and not is able to set any arlams... 
I just put it to vibration and it is working...  That should be told in any tutorial - it had helped to use my time better 😅😅😅

@Hangasilly 
> It seems like you put your phone to SILENT, the Libre2-App thinks, that it have to remain like this and not is able to set any arlams...
> I just put it to vibration and it is working... That should be told in any tutorial - it had helped to use my time better

That is written somewhere in the Libre manual and is not related to xDrip. Another issue of the patched app may arise nightly, if this app gets suspended by Android because of no activity. You have to whitelist the app.

It seems the problem was resolved for the individual who opened this issue.
If anyone else has issues, would you please use the support channels to ask instead of opening an issue?
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5
https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus
Thanks
